GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-09-12T16:37:40Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Linked cancellation token source where all tokens must be cancelled
Description: This is more of an question of whether such functionality exists within the coreclr already.

I've used `CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource` to get a `CancellationToken` which will be cancelled when any of the subject tokens are cancelled.

My current scenario is I invoke an HTTP API and I would like to record in Entity Framework the result of that call.  Currently the EF call uses the same token I used for the HTTP API.  This works fine so long the token does not become cancelled.

The obvious solution to use a separate `CancellationToken` for the database call, which resulted in me making a small one that expires after 3 seconds, works fine for most scenarios but sometimes it operation takes longer than 3 seconds, so despite the first token still having time left left, the database operation fails due to the 3 second token.

My question is: 
Is there functionality within the `CancellationTokenSource` class (or elsewhere) that creates a linked token where *all* of the subject tokens must be cancelled for the derived one to be considered cancelled?
